subject: [RFC PATCH 53/57] selftests/mm: cover collapse of mlocked ranges

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch adds self-tests to cover the collapse of mlocked ranges in the Linux kernel. The tests ensure that when an mlocked range is collapsed, the source pages are properly munlocked and the new folio arrives locked as expected. The tests also verify that the collapse process works correctly under contention between threads locking and unlocking random spans across a region. The patch introduces a new function `collapse_order_mlocked` to handle this specific case of collapsing mlocked ranges.
